reason: The whole point only works once I connect my Google and drop the bot into the staff group, and that is exactly what I don't want a bot touching. Half of what I spend is cash to mechanics with no receipt anyway, so I'd be paying $19 a month to sort the easy half.
objection: They say it only sees one sheet and folder, but I can't check that, and once it sits in my work group it reads everything my staff say in there. I don't know who is behind it or where my numbers end up.
would_change_my_mind: A way to get the sheet without connecting Google at all, like a file it sends me every week, plus a clear name and company behind it that I can look up.
